recipes.name: Banitsa
recipes.description: Flaky filo pie with a savoury filling of eggs and Bulgarian white brined cheese.
instructions: Crumble cheese and mix with eggs, yogurt and baking soda
Brush a baking dish with oil
layer half the pastry sheets, brushing lightly
Spread filling, cover with remaining sheets and tuck edges
Bake at 190 C until puffed and deep golden
rest 10 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve warm for breakfast with yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use spinach with cheese for zelnik variation.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat in oven.
recipes.safety: Keep dairy filling chilled and cook egg mixture fully.

recipes.name: bg-patatnik
recipes.description: Grated potatoes baked with onion and herbs into a crisp-edged regional pie.
instructions: Squeeze excess liquid from grated potatoes
Mix with onion, crumbled cheese, eggs, mint, pepper and salt
Press into an oiled skillet or baking dish
Bake at 190 C until underside and top are golden and potatoes cooked, about 35 to 40 minutes
rest before slicing.
recipes.sides: Serve with yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta and parsley if sirene or mint is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 2 days; reheat in oven.
recipes.safety: Cook potato and egg mixture fully.

recipes.name: Bob chorba
recipes.description: White beans simmered with vegetables, mint and paprika into a warming soup.
instructions: Drain soaked beans and cover with fresh water
simmer until beginning to soften
Add diced onion, carrot and pepper
cook until beans are tender
Stir tomato paste and paprika with a little broth
add to pot and simmer 15 minutes
finish with mint and salt.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread and chopped parsley.
recipes.substitutions: Use canned beans and reduce simmering time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until bubbling.
recipes.safety: Boil dried beans thoroughly; soak refrigerated when warm.

recipes.name: Eggs with pepper relish
recipes.description: Fried eggs served over warm lyutenitsa with crumbled sirene cheese.
instructions: Warm lyutenitsa in a skillet over low heat
Make small wells and add eggs
cover until whites set
Crumble cheese over top and add parsley
serve from pan.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread for breakfast.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta or omit cheese.
recipes.storage: Best served fresh.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs until whites are set; keep relish refrigerated before use.

recipes.name: Gyuvech
recipes.description: A clay-pot style casserole of peppers, tomatoes, aubergine and potatoes.
instructions: Cut vegetables into similar-sized pieces
salt aubergine 15 minutes then pat dry
Layer onion, potatoes, peppers, aubergine and tomatoes in an ovenproof dish
season with paprika and oil
Cover and bake at 180 C until vegetables are tender, about 50 minutes
uncover to reduce excess liquid
garnish.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread and yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Add cooked beans or sausage for a heartier version.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Cook vegetables fully and chill leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Kachamak
recipes.description: Thick cornmeal cooked in salted water and finished with butter and sirene.
instructions: Bring salted water to a boil
Whisk cornmeal in gradually, stirring to prevent lumps
Cook over low heat, stirring often, until smooth and thick
Stir in butter and crumble cheese over top
serve hot.
recipes.sides: Serve with yogurt or fried onions.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta or omit dairy.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers and reheat with water.
recipes.safety: Stir carefully to avoid hot splashes.

recipes.name: Kapama
recipes.description: A slow oven casserole layered with pork, chicken, sausage, rice and sour cabbage.
instructions: Rinse sauerkraut lightly if very sour
Layer sauerkraut, onion, meat pieces, sausage and rinsed rice in a covered casserole
Sprinkle paprika and add stock
cover tightly
Bake at 160 C until meats are tender and rice cooked, about 2.5 to 3 hours
stir carefully before serving.
recipes.sides: Serve hot with bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use one meat type and add beans for a simpler casserole.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly.
recipes.safety: Cook poultry and pork fully; cool leftovers quickly.

recipes.name: Katmi
recipes.description: Thin yeasted batter pancakes cooked on a hot griddle and served with cheese or jam.
instructions: Whisk flour, egg, milk, yeast, sugar and salt into a smooth batter
cover and rise 40 minutes
Heat a lightly oiled griddle
ladle a thin round of batter and spread gently
Cook until bubbles form and underside is golden
flip and cook the other side
repeat.
recipes.sides: Serve with sirene, honey or jam.
recipes.substitutions: Use kefir for a tangier batter.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook egg batter through.

recipes.name: Kavarma
recipes.description: Pork, onions, peppers and tomatoes braised slowly in a covered casserole.
instructions: Brown pork in oil in batches
add onions and cook until soft
Stir in peppers, tomatoes, paprika and bay
pour in stock
Cover and braise at 170 C until pork is tender, about 75 minutes
uncover briefly to thicken sauce.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread or rice.
recipes.substitutions: Use chicken thighs and shorten the braise.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook pork thoroughly and cool leftovers quickly.

recipes.name: Kebapche
recipes.description: Peppery minced meat shaped into short rolls and grilled until browned.
instructions: Mix meats, salt, pepper, cumin, baking soda and water
knead until tacky
Cover and chill at least 2 hours
Shape into short even rolls
Grill or pan-grill over medium-high heat, turning until browned and cooked through.
recipes.sides: Serve with lyutenitsa, bread and shopska salad.
recipes.substitutions: Use all beef if preferred.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate raw mixture up to 24 hours; cooked rolls keep 2 days chilled.
recipes.safety: Cook minced meat fully through and keep raw utensils separate.

recipes.name: Kiselo mlyako
recipes.description: Thick tangy yogurt served with honey and walnuts as a simple breakfast or snack.
instructions: Spoon cold yogurt into bowls
Drizzle with honey and add chopped walnuts
Add a small spoon of rose jam if desired and serve.
recipes.sides: Add seasonal fruit or oats.
recipes.substitutions: Use any unsweetened thick yogurt.
recipes.storage: Keep refrigerated and serve immediately.
recipes.safety: Keep dairy chilled and avoid cross-contact with nuts.

recipes.name: Kozunak
recipes.description: Soft enriched yeast bread with citrus zest and raisins, often braided for holidays.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, milk, eggs and sugar into dough
knead in softened butter gradually
Knead until elastic, cover and rise until doubled
Fold in raisins and lemon zest
divide and braid
let rise again
Brush with egg and bake at 175 C until deep golden and cooked, 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve sliced with coffee or jam.
recipes.substitutions: Use orange zest and dried cranberries.
recipes.storage: Store covered at room temperature for 2 days; freeze slices.
recipes.safety: Bake through the centre and cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Kyufte
recipes.description: Flat seasoned meat patties with onion, parsley and cumin, grilled or pan-fried.
instructions: Mix mince with onion, spices, parsley, salt and pepper
rest chilled 30 minutes
Shape into 8 flat patties
Grill or pan-fry in a little oil, turning once, until browned and cooked through.
recipes.sides: Serve with potato salad and pickles.
recipes.substitutions: Use turkey mince, adding a spoon of yogurt for moisture.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked patties up to 2 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Cook patties through to the centre.

recipes.name: Lyutenitsa
recipes.description: Slow-cooked roasted peppers and tomatoes blended into a sweet savoury relish.
instructions: Roast peppers under a grill until blistered
cover, cool and peel
Roast tomatoes and carrot until soft
peel tomatoes and chop vegetables
Cook pepper, tomato, carrot and garlic in a wide pot until thick, stirring often
Stir in oil, sugar, vinegar and salt
cool and refrigerate.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread, cheese or grilled meat.
recipes.substitutions: Use jarred roasted peppers and simmer shorter.
recipes.storage: Keep refrigerated up to 1 week; for shelf storage use tested canning guidance.
recipes.safety: This refrigerator relish is not a validated canning recipe; keep chilled.

recipes.name: Mekitsi
recipes.description: Soft yogurt dough fried in small rounds and served sweet or savoury.
instructions: Mix flour, yogurt, egg, yeast, sugar and salt into a soft dough
cover and rise until doubled
Divide into small balls and flatten into rounds
Fry in medium-hot oil, turning once, until golden and cooked through
drain on a rack.
recipes.sides: Serve with jam, honey or sirene.
recipes.substitutions: Use kefir in place of yogurt.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; store leftovers covered and use within a day.
recipes.safety: Keep oil monitored and cook dough through the centre.

recipes.name: Milinki
recipes.description: Soft yeast rolls brushed with butter and topped with salty cheese crumbs.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, milk, egg, sugar and salt
knead until smooth and rise until doubled
Divide into small balls and arrange closely in a buttered pan
rise 30 minutes
Brush with melted butter and crumble cheese over
Bake at 190 C until golden and cooked through, about 25 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve warm for breakfast.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta or a brined sheep cheese.
recipes.storage: Store covered up to 2 days; reheat gently.
recipes.safety: Cool before storing and keep dairy bread refrigerated if warm.

recipes.name: Mish-mash
recipes.description: A quick summer skillet of peppers, tomatoes, eggs and crumbled sirene cheese.
instructions: Cook onion and peppers in oil until soft
Add tomatoes and simmer until saucy
Beat eggs lightly and pour into pan
stir gently until just set
Crumble cheese over top and finish with parsley.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread as a light meal.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta or omit cheese.
recipes.storage: Best served immediately; refrigerate leftovers for no more than 1 day.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs until set and keep leftovers chilled.

recipes.name: Musaka
recipes.description: Potatoes baked with minced meat and tomato, finished with a yogurt and egg topping.
instructions: Cook onion and mince in a pan until browned
add tomatoes and paprika and simmer 10 minutes
Layer diced potatoes and meat sauce in a baking dish
add 200 ml water
Bake at 190 C until potatoes are tender, about 40 minutes
Whisk yogurt, eggs and flour
spread over top and bake until set and golden.
recipes.sides: Serve warm with salad.
recipes.substitutions: Use minced pork or lentils.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook meat fully and set egg topping before serving.

recipes.name: Oshav
recipes.description: Dried apples, pears and plums simmered with cinnamon into a gently sweet drink and dessert.
ingredients: 200 g mixed dried apples, pears and prunes
instructions: Rinse dried fruit
Place fruit, water, cinnamon and lemon peel in a pot
simmer gently until fruit softens, 25 to 30 minutes
Cool slightly, sweeten with honey and serve warm or chilled.
recipes.sides: Serve as a drink with fruit spooned into bowls.
recipes.substitutions: Use raisins or dried apricots in the fruit mix.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate covered and use within 3 days.
recipes.safety: Cool promptly and keep chilled.

recipes.name: Palneni chushki
recipes.englishName: Stuffed peppers with rice and mince
recipes.description: Bell peppers filled with rice, minced meat and herbs, baked in tomato sauce.
instructions: Cook onion until soft
stir in mince and cook until browned
add rinsed rice, paprika and parsley
Trim pepper tops and remove seeds
fill loosely with mixture
Stand in a baking dish and pour passata around them
cover with foil and bake at 190 C until filling is cooked and peppers tender.
recipes.sides: Serve with yogurt and bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use lentils and cooked rice for a meat-free filling.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook minced meat and rice completely; avoid overfilling peppers.

recipes.name: Ribena chorba
recipes.description: A light fish soup with tomatoes, peppers and herbs, finished with lemon.
instructions: Cook onion and pepper in a little oil until soft
Add tomatoes, diced potato, bay and stock
simmer until potato is almost tender
Add fish chunks and poach gently until opaque and flaking
Remove bay
finish with parsley and lemon.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use freshwater fish or mixed white fish.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly and use within 1 day; reheat gently.
recipes.safety: Keep fish chilled and cook until opaque.

recipes.name: Salata s kartofi
recipes.description: Boiled potatoes tossed warm with onion, parsley, oil and vinegar.
instructions: Boil potatoes whole until just tender
drain, cool slightly and peel
Slice while warm and place in a bowl
Add finely sliced onion, oil, vinegar, parsley, salt and pepper
toss gently and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve with grilled kebapche or fish.
recipes.substitutions: Add chopped pickles or spring onion.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Chill leftovers quickly and keep covered.

recipes.name: Sarmi
recipes.englishName: Cabbage rolls with rice and pork
recipes.description: Sour cabbage leaves wrapped around rice and minced pork, simmered gently in broth.
instructions: Mix pork, rinsed rice, diced onion, paprika, salt and pepper
Place filling on cabbage leaves, fold sides and roll tightly
Arrange rolls seam-down in a pot
mix stock and tomato paste and pour over
simmer covered until rice and pork are cooked, about 75 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve with yogurt or sour cream.
recipes.substitutions: Use fresh blanched cabbage with a little lemon juice.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook pork and rice filling fully through.

recipes.name: Shkembe chorba
recipes.description: Slow-simmered tripe soup finished with paprika oil, garlic and vinegar.
instructions: Simmer cleaned tripe in water until very tender, 2 to 2.5 hours
remove and slice thinly
Return tripe to broth
stir in milk and warm gently without boiling
Melt butter, bloom paprika briefly and drizzle over soup
Serve with crushed garlic mixed with vinegar.
recipes.sides: Serve hot with bread and chilli flakes.
recipes.substitutions: Use well-cleaned pre-cooked tripe and shorten simmer.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Use only food-grade cleaned tripe; keep soup chilled and reheat thoroughly.

recipes.name: Shopska salata
recipes.description: Chopped tomato, cucumber, pepper and onion finished with grated white brined cheese.
instructions: Dice tomato, cucumber and pepper into similar pieces
Slice onion thinly and mix with vegetables
Dress lightly with oil, vinegar and salt
Grate cheese generously over top and finish with parsley.
recipes.sides: Serve chilled alongside grilled dishes.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta if sirene is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Best freshly prepared; refrigerate only briefly.
recipes.safety: Wash vegetables well and keep salad chilled.

recipes.name: Sirene po shopski
recipes.englishName: Baked cheese with tomato and pepper
recipes.description: Sirene cheese baked in a small dish with tomato, pepper and egg.
instructions: Butter a small ovenproof dish
add cheese, tomato and pepper
Sprinkle paprika and bake at 190 C until tomato softens and cheese warms
Crack egg on top and bake until white is set
serve in dish.
recipes.sides: Serve with crusty bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta or another brined cheese.
recipes.storage: Best served immediately.
recipes.safety: Bake egg until white is set; dish will be very hot.

recipes.name: Snezhanka
recipes.description: Thick yogurt, cucumber, dill and garlic served as a cool side salad.
instructions: Grate cucumber and squeeze out excess liquid
Stir cucumber with yogurt, crushed garlic, dill and salt
Drizzle with oil and chill briefly before serving.
recipes.sides: Serve beside grilled dishes or bread.
recipes.substitutions: Add crushed walnuts if desired.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate and use within 24 hours.
recipes.safety: Keep yogurt cold and use clean utensils.

recipes.name: Tarator
recipes.description: Chilled yogurt soup with cucumber, garlic, dill and walnuts for hot weather.
instructions: Whisk yogurt with cold water until smooth
Dice cucumber finely and stir it in
Crush garlic with salt and mix with dill and oil
Fold into yogurt, chill 30 minutes and top with chopped walnuts.
recipes.sides: Serve cold with bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use kefir for a thinner soup.
recipes.storage: Keep refrigerated and use within 24 hours.
recipes.safety: Keep dairy cold and use clean utensils.

recipes.name: Tikvenik
recipes.description: Sweet spiral filo pastry filled with pumpkin, walnuts, cinnamon and sugar.
instructions: Cook grated pumpkin in a pan until it softens and moisture evaporates
cool
Mix with sugar, walnuts and cinnamon
Brush filo lightly with oil
spread filling along edge and roll
coil into a greased dish
Bake at 190 C until crisp and golden
cool before slicing.
recipes.sides: Dust with icing sugar and serve with tea.
recipes.substitutions: Use grated apple mixed with pumpkin.
recipes.storage: Store covered at room temperature for 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cool filling before handling filo; check nut allergies.

recipes.name: Zelnik s kiselo zele
recipes.description: Sour cabbage simmered with beans and paprika for a simple winter meal.
instructions: Cook onion in oil until soft
Add paprika and stir briefly
add sauerkraut, bay and stock
simmer until cabbage is tender, about 35 minutes
Fold in beans and warm through
season to taste.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread or polenta.
recipes.substitutions: Use fresh cabbage with a splash of vinegar.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook beans thoroughly and chill leftovers promptly.
